method: Source-pinned author-side delta controls. Only explicitly named, source-justified unchanged canonical predicates may reuse an existing author judgment; case/version matches and identical rationales alone are not semantic proof. All other cases require their existing independent author examination or remain unresolved for reuse. No independent reviewer or target execution is asserted.

controls.change_claim: Version 0.2 changes request pageSize to limit, response cursor/truncated to nextCursor; continuation must use the 0.2 contract. The other privacy and authority controls remain separately source-checked; no entire-version equivalence is asserted.

inheritance.unchanged_normative_requirement: In both pinned audit/list specifications the audit-read capability remains community-wide: a context-scoped administrator MUST NOT receive the whole-log tail merely because they can administer their context.
inheritance.semantic_justification: Version 0.2 changes request and response pagination fields, but not the actor's community-wide audit-read authority requirement. The same consumer failure proposition and authority boundary remain documented in both author-side case records. This is scoped to DTF-002 and does not imply complete version equivalence.
inheritance.negative_control: Present a request for the full audit tail signed by a context-scoped administrator who lacks community-wide audit-read capability; both source versions must reject the request rather than elevate signature validity into sufficient authority.

controls.change_claim: 1.1 renames the 1.0 request since cursor to syncToken and response cursor to nextSyncToken, and requires tokens to be issued by the consumer; the incremental semantics remain similar but the wire fields are incompatible.

0.2 adds optional evidence (WebAuthn or approverSigned) and actionId for parked VTC actions. The required approver-own-DID assertionMethod proof remains the authorization and evidence is additional, not a substitute. 0.2 allows executor to run parked VTC action at threshold; do not assume entire-version equivalence.
0.2 changes frameworkVersion from MAJOR.MINOR to MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; 0.1 and 0.2 responses are not wire-interchangeable for strict schema consumers, while discovery remains advisory.

0.3 adds optional acceptanceWindow with maxAgeSeconds/clockSkewSeconds; 0.2's closed schema rejects the new field and the window governs issuedAt even if expiresAt is present. Do not assume wire or temporal equivalence.

0.4 adds optional expiryHorizonSeconds to acceptanceWindow to distinguish documents with expiresAt from maxAgeSeconds-only cases; 0.3's closed schema rejects this field, and 0.3's issuedAt-only window cannot be presumed equivalent.
